evidence.reason: The code closes the observation and emits `report.observation.status` directly from `observation.status` without forwarding `collected` units' `observationFailures` through `observationFailure()`. Per-unit observation failures therefore do not affect the aggregate observation status, so a report can still claim `durable` or `unavailable` even when attempt-observation evidence is incomplete. The proposed fold before `closeObservation()` addresses an ordinary status-accuracy defect; no contract clause contradicts it.
